description: Join a dedicated team as a Full-time Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) in Alpine, AL. This role offers the unique opportunity to provide essential therapy services within a home health setting, making a direct impact on patients' lives in their own environments. We are seeking a compassionate and skilled professional ready to deliver high-quality care.As a PTA, you will work under the supervision of a licensed Physical Therapist, implementing individualized treatment plans to help patients regain mobility, reduce pain, and improve their overall functional abilities. This traveling position requires excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage a caseload effectively while providing personalized, one-on-one care.Compensation for this role is structured at $35 per visit, offering a clear and rewarding pay model. Interview scheduling is flexible, with availability Monday-Friday from 1PM-7PM and over the weekend as needed to accommodate your schedule.
requirements: Associate's degree from an accredited Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) program
Current and valid Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) license in Alabama
Valid driver's license and reliable transportation
Ability to work independently and manage a caseload effectively
